## Data frame de Iris

```{r}
df = iris
head(df, 5)
tail(df, 5)

str(df)
names(df) # equivalente a colnames(df)
rownames(df)
dimnames(df)

dim(df)

df$Petal.Length[1:10]
df$Species[1:10]
```

## Acceso al Data frame

```{r}
df[1:10, ]
df[1:10, 2:4]
df[df$Species == "setosa" & df$Sepal.Width > 4, ]
df[df$Species == "setosa" & df$Sepal.Width > 4, ][c(1, 3), c(2, 5)]
```
